# Protoyard

> Protoyard builds prototypes that feel real: apps, slide decks, landing pages and documents described as data-only JSON blueprints, played in the browser with no backend (fictional data only), or generated into Vite + Svelte 5 prototypes. Real behavior. Fake infrastructure.

## Decks for agents

A slide deck is a `kind: "deck"` JSON blueprint, never Reveal.js Markdown or HTML. The loop: learn the format, write JSON, lint it, play it, point at a slide with the debug panel's reference, resolve it, fix it.

- [Decks guide](https://protoyard.app/docs/decks/): the agent loop, the deck JSON, layouts and when to use them, steps, custom slides and limits
- [Recipes](https://protoyard.app/docs/decks/#recipes): a chart story, a comparison table, a live poll, a calculator, an embedded app and a custom interactive slide, each one valid JSON
- [Reference deck](https://github.com/DailybotHQ/protoyard/blob/main/blueprints/decks/everything.json): 42 slides that use every layout, every block type and every chart family, with steps, a media background, explorable data and interactive blocks, to copy from (`protoyard deck inspect blueprints/decks/everything.json --slide <id>`)
- [Flagship deck](https://github.com/DailybotHQ/protoyard/blob/main/blueprints/decks/protoyard-create-anything.json): a real talk built on the same catalog
- `protoyard deck schema`: prints the deck JSON Schema (draft 2020-12)
- `protoyard deck layouts [id]` and `protoyard deck blocks [type]`: every layout and block with when to use it, its limits and a valid sample
- `protoyard deck lint <file|slug>`: findings with JSON pointers and fixes
- `protoyard deck inspect <file|slug> --ref "<[slide-ref] line>"`: resolves a reference copied from the deck's "Debug for agents" panel (press D; add ?debug=1 in the player) to the file, the JSON pointer and the slide JSON
- `protoyard deck capabilities`: what decks support in the player (level 1) and in a generated prototype (level 2)

## More

- [Documentation](https://protoyard.app/docs/): every public guide
- [Agent guide](https://protoyard.app/docs/agent_guide/): the build loop for prototypes
- [Player](https://protoyard.app/docs/player/): play any blueprint with no install
